name: NR-96 main-menu prebuild: clones built at the menu are used by the world, and a second world load still gets correct clones and looks
description: Item clones and their looks are built at the main menu; entering a world only registers them (when their definition still matches). Then a relog goes back to the menu and loads the world again: the clones are built fresh and the looks built again on the new copies (Forge used to keep the destroyed copy).
